name: mudlet-toolbox
description: Build, debug, and validate Mudlet packages, Lua scripts, comprehensive Geyser interfaces, protocols, and maps.

interface.longDescription: Six focused skills for Mudlet package development, Lua scripting, events and protocols, comprehensive Geyser interfaces, mapping, and package testing, aligned with official Mudlet guidance. Includes a Muddler starter, Lua examples, and a read-only package inspector.
defaultPrompt: Create a Mudlet package with an alias and clean lifecycle.
Build a responsive, dockable Geyser dashboard with saved layout.
Inspect and test a Mudlet package for lifecycle and best-practice issues.
